name: Eucerin Pigment Control Tinted SPF 50+ 50ml
description: Eucerin Sun Protection Innovation with Advanced Spectral Technology combines UVA/UVB filters for very high UV protection and Licohalcone A for neutralization of free radicals induced by UV and high-energy visible light. Effectively reduces dark spots and helps to prevent their re-appearance with regular usage. With color pigments for a dual effect: Instantly unifies complexion & provides additional defense against HEVIS induced pigmentation
